name: 马尼拉圣奥古斯丁教堂
subject: 现存教堂正立面与钟塔
author: LMP 2001

references.author: LMP 2001
references.description: Main façade of the San Agustin Church in Intramuros, the oldest stone church in the Philippines still standing after four centuries since it was completed in 1607.

sources.author: LMP 2001
sources.description: Main façade of the San Agustin Church in Intramuros, the oldest stone church in the Philippines still standing after four centuries since it was completed in 1607.

structure_checkpoints: Portrait 1024x1536. Draw the present San Agustin Church Manila facade including the SINGLE standing attached bell tower at RIGHT, full main facade and ground doorway. Main triangular pediment has a round rose window and cross, below are paired pilasters, a rectangular center upper window flanked by TWO arched niches, and the large arched entrance. The left bell tower is lost: keep its surviving low masonry stump rather than rebuilding another symmetrical tower. Remove cars, tree, people and adjacent monastery wings.
material_observations: 浅灰米色石墙、灰褐柱式与门窗框、深褐门及暗窗口、屋缘少量红瓦，钟塔浅灰。
source_note: 依据所列实拍进行艺术简化；范围为现存教堂正立面与钟塔。原型待用户人眼验收，不作实测或文保复原声明。

All unmarked surfaces inside and outside remain pure white; use outlines for doors and windows rather than dark fills. No solid shadows, broad grey shading, crosshatching, pencil grain, paper texture, gradient, color, gold, halo, cast shadow or checkerboard. Draw only ink strokes; the white background will be removed by a local script.

No labels, letters, calligraphy, dimension lines, captions, watermark, frame or border. Subject occupies about 82% of canvas width/height, apex and base uncut, with generous balanced margins.
